_comment: BlueBird Kiosk OS — managed Chromium policy. Belt-and-suspenders for the --disable-features flags in launch-kiosk-chromium: the policy file applies even if the user-data-dir is wiped or chromium changes which CLI feature names it honors. Also auto-allows the Local Network Access permission for the Legacy Wall origins so the kiosk_cache shim (which fetches http://127.0.0.1:7311 from the HTTPS cloud page) doesn't trigger an 'Access other apps and services on this device' prompt.
